acceptanceCriteria.text: Claims require actual worker-shell/child-tool evidence; fixtures and cleanup own isolated resources and combined work is tested early at meaningful row/increment boundaries.
Bounded instrumented diagnostics are distinct from acceptance; cause-specific repair scope avoids needless plan churn without waiving failed checks, saved scope, retry authority or deadlines.

Host-heavy checks have explicit cross-agent scheduling and release guidance, not an implied global lock; shipped guidance/version remain valid and required verification results are recorded truthfully.

body:
## Outcome
Update shipped planning/orchestration guidance to prevent the observed revision-loop failure modes without weakening quality gates or human authority. This is a standalone policy improvement, not a change to either running epic.
## Source locations
skills/planner.md; skills/graph-planner.md; skills/orchestrator.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/claim-prerequisites.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/setup.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/time-box-limits.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/time-box.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/sprint-shape.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/row-checks.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/acceptance-round.md; src/core/version.ts. Planner/graph and sprint-shape: size demonstrable increments before a large acceptance bottleneck; early targeted combined row checks, not per-ticket full suites. Claim/setup: actual worker shell and child Node/npm/Git resolution, pinned dependencies, Windows capabilities before claim. Time-box guidance: permit bounded hypothesis-driven diagnostic observations within authorized scope, verify instrumentation reaches the actual worker and writes readable measurements first, preserve original failed gate; two unproductive rounds mean reassess, not mechanically create a revision for every instrumentation error. Repair scope states outcome and likely source/fixture entry points without falsely forbidding a needed cause-specific production correction. Verification guidance: isolated fixture/temp roots and owned cleanup, no shared directory snapshots; mail-based explicit coordination of host-heavy checks with ownership/deadline/release, never assume silence grants a slot or kill another owner's job. Keep saved scope/consent/retry/checkpoint controls. Bump shipped skills version beyond installed1.13.0 to1.14.0.
## Tests
No new runtime logic or phrase-pinning tests. Existing knowledge parsing/budget/selection and skills/server distribution checks cover packaging. Independently evaluate workflow scenarios; remove obsolete exact-wording test assertions rather than repin them if encountered (report outside-owned test changes to coordinator). Full lint/test/typecheck/deadcode/build gate once after edits; Fireguard on combined committed changes if tests modified.
## Preflight
Windows x64, main checkout; Node24.22.3/npm11.19.1 at C:/Users/davgo/tools/node24; direct executable and child node/git resolution verified with Windows PATH prepended. Existing node_modules resolve Vitest/oxlint/TypeScript/electron-vite. No install. Preserve unrelated .darkmechanicus state.
## Verification exception
Implementation remains bounded; final combined automated gate has a predeclared 20-minute finite deadline, including Fireguard if needed, no timeout changes or retries for green. Coordinator runs one serialized combined verification after both independent documentation changes, citing identical source state in both submissions.
title: Prevent revision churn with executable preflight and bounded diagnostics
